\"\"\"Best Book Awards persistence and nomination rules.\"\"\"

import pytest
import web

from openlibrary.core import db
from openlibrary.core.bookshelves import Bookshelves


@pytest.fixture
def awards_db(monkeypatch):
    database = web.database(dbn='sqlite', db=':memory:')
    monkeypatch.setattr(db, 'get_db', lambda: database)
    database.query('CREATE TABLE bookshelves_books (username text, work_id integer, bookshelf_id integer)')

        edition_id integer, UNIQUE(username, work_id), UNIQUE(username, topic))''')
    return database


def test_nomination_requires_already_read_and_is_unique(awards_db):
    \"\"\"Removing the read check or either uniqueness check would break this test.\"\"\"
    from openlibrary.core.bestbook import Bestbook

    with pytest.raises(Bestbook.AwardConditionsError, match='Only books which have been marked as read may be given awards'):
        Bestbook.add('reader', '1', 'fiction')
    awards_db.insert('bookshelves_books', username='reader', work_id=1, bookshelf_id=3)
    awards_db.insert('bookshelves_books', username='reader', work_id=2, bookshelf_id=3)
    assert Bookshelves.user_has_read_work('reader', '1')
    award_id = Bestbook.add('reader', '1', 'fiction', comment='Loved it', edition_id=5)
    assert award_id > 0
    with pytest.raises(Bestbook.AwardConditionsError):
        Bestbook.add('reader', '1', 'history')
    with pytest.raises(Bestbook.AwardConditionsError):
        Bestbook.add('reader', '2', 'fiction')
    assert Bestbook.get_count(username='reader') == 1
    assert Bestbook.get_awards(work_id='1')[0].comment == 'Loved it'
    assert Bestbook.get_count(topic='history') == 0
    assert Bestbook.remove('reader', work_id='1') == 1
    assert Bestbook.get_count(work_id='1') == 0


def test_redirect_and_anonymization_preserve_award(awards_db):
    \"\"\"A missing work or username update leaves the nomination under an old identity.\"\"\"
    from openlibrary.core.bestbook import Bestbook

    awards_db.insert('bookshelves_books', username='reader', work_id=1, bookshelf_id=3)
    Bestbook.add('reader', '1', 'fiction')
    assert Bestbook.update_work_id(1, 2)['rows_changed'] == 1
    assert Bestbook.update_username('reader', 'anonymous-reader') == 1
    assert Bestbook.get_count(work_id='2', username='anonymous-reader') == 1
    assert Bestbook.get_count(work_id='1') == 0

def test_awards_api_add_update_remove_and_count(awards_db, monkeypatch):
    \"\"\"A missing API branch or missing persistence changes the JSON response.\"\"\"
    import json

    from openlibrary import accounts
    from openlibrary.plugins.openlibrary import api

    class User:
        key = '/people/reader'

    monkeypatch.setattr(accounts, 'get_current_user', lambda: None)
    monkeypatch.setattr(web, 'input', lambda **defaults: web.storage(op='add', topic='fiction', comment='First', edition_key='OL5M'))
    assert json.loads(api.bestbook_award().POST('1').rawtext) == {'errors': 'Authentication failed'}

    monkeypatch.setattr(accounts, 'get_current_user', lambda: User())
    assert 'Only books which have been marked as read' in json.loads(api.bestbook_award().POST('1').rawtext)['errors']
    awards_db.insert('bookshelves_books', username='reader', work_id=1, bookshelf_id=3)
    assert json.loads(api.bestbook_award().POST('1').rawtext)['success'] is True
    assert json.loads(api.bestbook_count().GET().rawtext) == {'count': 1}
    monkeypatch.setattr(web, 'input', lambda **defaults: web.storage(op='update', topic='history', comment='Updated', edition_key=None, work_id='1', username='reader'))
    assert json.loads(api.bestbook_award().POST('1').rawtext)['success'] is True
    assert json.loads(api.bestbook_count().GET().rawtext) == {'count': 1}
    assert awards_db.select('bestbook_awards')[0].topic == 'history'
    monkeypatch.setattr(web, 'input', lambda **defaults: web.storage(op='remove', topic=None, comment=None, edition_key=None, work_id='1', username='reader'))
    assert json.loads(api.bestbook_award().POST('1').rawtext) == {'success': True, 'rows': 1}
    assert json.loads(api.bestbook_count().GET().rawtext) == {'count': 0}


def test_work_award_accessors(awards_db):
    \"\"\"Work accessors must reflect persisted nominations for a specific reader.\"\"\"
    from openlibrary.core.bestbook import Bestbook
    from openlibrary.core.models import Work

    awards_db.insert('bookshelves_books', username='reader', work_id=1, bookshelf_id=3)
    Bestbook.add('reader', '1', 'fiction')
    work = Work(None, '/works/OL1W', data={'key': '/works/OL1W', 'type': {'key': '/type/work'}})
    assert len(work.get_awards()) == 1
    assert work.check_if_user_awarded('reader')
    assert not work.check_if_user_awarded('other')
    assert work.get_award_by_username('reader').topic == 'fiction'
